headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: Kyle Fletcher vs. Mark Briscoe clashed for the AEW TNT Title in a Ladder match, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 8.29 ? an excellent showing. Fletcher and Briscoe renewed their rivalry down under, the TNT Champion defending against the man who's given him more trouble than almost anyone else in AEW.
Flash back to 2024, when Orange Cassidy vs. Matt Taven fought it out in a Texas Death Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.78 ? a solid showing in a hard-fought men's division clash.
It was 2024 when Matt Jackson was no more, reborn as Matthew Jackson after 117 matches, on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2026, when MJF vs. Brody King clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 7.07 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Back on this day in 2026, Jon Moxley vs. Konosuke Takeshita fought tooth and nail for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 7.73 ? a match that delivered.

Looking back to 2026, when Babes Of Wrath vs. MegaBad clashed for the AEW Women's World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 5.56. For MegaBad, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
